mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_option_group (product_id, option_group_id, is_required, allow_multiple, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{optionGroupId}), #{isRequired}, #{allowMultiple}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_required = VALUES(is_required), allow_multiple = VALUES(allow_multiple)
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, BIN_TO_UUID(option_group_id) AS option_group_id, is_required, allow_multiple, created_at FROM product_option_group WHERE option_group_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{optionGroupId})

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, BIN_TO_UUID(option_group_id) AS option_group_id, is_required, allow_multiple, created_at FROM product_option_group WHERE product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId}) AND option_group_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{optionGroupId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_option_group WHERE product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId})
